D1_backend.no_gradient_claim: secants are finite-step responses, not derivatives; sdf_gradient_qualified stays false; #23, #24, #25 stay open
open_questions: the negative even parts of unknown cause

supersedes.scope: OPT-01 v1 only; #25 stays open for any high-dimensional backend, FD stays verification-only beyond 8 directions
sentences: #30 (OPT-01) still depends on #25 and #26 to #29: there is no separate "first accepted update" gate before them, and the LOWDIM-03/04 parent remains an experimental state under false flags.
No further LOWDIM cycle is planned (exit rule recorded in the LOWDIM-04 Stage B entry).

D1_backend.text: The first OPT-01 step's update direction is the LOWDIM-04 L1-robust cone solution on dual-grid centered phi-space secants (+-1.25 mm) of the frozen 4-direction basis (D0, D1, D2, P1; hand-picked, not rule-selected): a subspace step, cost 2k+1 runs per grid. The 8-direction cap is a budget, not a justification.

D3_update.accept: strictly more than 3e-5 N downforce gain and drag change <= 0 on both grids, plus every gate above

constraints.drag: computed drag change <= 0 on both grids; flow_32 changes under 3e-5 N flagged 'small'
constraints.geom02_gate_profile_v2: proposal states: all 13 gates hard; probe states: twelve hard, near_zero_gradient_band report-only (gate_scope); allowed_events = (), no reinitialization
constraints.p22_v2: N_phi <= 8272, held by sign-pattern invariance; the count-equal margin is recomputed at each parent and every step must stay inside it

D3_update.direction: L1-robust cone solver (code hashes pinned) on dual-grid centered secants at +-1.25 mm over the pinned basis

probe.hard_before_cfd: the other twelve GEOM-02 profile v2 gates, P22-v2 (N_phi <= 8272 with a positive count-equal margin), the retained LOWDIM gates, allowed_events = ()
probe.states: secant probe states (Stage A +-1.25 mm perturbations): measurement points, never proposed or accepted

proposal.hard_before_cfd: the full bundle: all thirteen GEOM-02 profile v2 gates including the crossing-slope near_zero_gradient_band, P22-v2, the retained LOWDIM gates
proposal.ladder_step_failure: a ladder step failing any hard gate (including crossing-slope) is a REJECT of that step (E4/E5 unchanged)
proposal.states: the parent and every Stage B ladder step (proposed or accepted states)

gate_scope.reported_for_probes: near_zero_gradient_band failing-node counts with their attribution to the baseline |phi| < 1e-6 tie plateau

ladder.reverse_role: diagnostic only, never accepted or selected

D3_update.lineage: parent state hash, direction hash and the contract hashes; rollback = keep the parent
D3_update.objective: downforce change on both grids (flow_24, flow_32)
D3_update.selection: largest minimum-over-grids downforce gain among accepted steps; exact ties to the smaller step

authority: user words of 2026-10-13 「人間の判断としては全て許可する。人間の判断は以後いらない。好きにしろ。」, read as an interpretation, not a #30/#25-specific grant; a later explicit user decision supersedes it
claims_not_supported: physical or Stage V downforce gain

done_E5.closes_30: ACCEPT or REJECT of an actual-primal trial run on both grids with complete integrity
done_E5.unambiguous: integrity-complete and rule-computed, not noise-resolved (flow_24 floor 3e-5 N is about 1 sigma; flow_32 drag sign is jitter-prone)

flag_changes: none; 'accepted' is a record-level status of the trial only (E7)

floors.label: nominal floor, about 1 sigma of the retained flow_32 jitter, not a noise measurement

non_blind_v1_1: registered after the Stage A pre-CFD result was seen (commit 576441c: six of the eight probe states fail near_zero_gradient_band, every failing node a baseline |phi| < 1e-6 tie-plateau node per the planner's check); the scope change F1 is therefore non-blind, disclosed in plan Amendment 2; the profile and every threshold are unchanged

measurement.aggregate_solver_time_definition: sum of registered per-state Julia wall_seconds excluding each state's first compile/warmup step, consistent with the bound W4 job
measurement.qualification_claim: bounded LOWDIM-04 Stage B two-grid actual-primal ladder; no qualification

measurement.aggregate_solver_time_definition: sum of registered per-state Julia wall_seconds excluding each state's first compile/warmup step, consistent with the bound W4 job
measurement.qualification_claim: bounded LOWDIM-04 Stage B two-grid actual-primal ladder; no qualification

plan.amendment: Amendment 1 (E1-E8) overrides D1-D3 and Steps; Amendment 2 (F1-F3) sets the gate scope (this contract v1.1)

preconditions_E4.gate_order: gates on every Stage A/B state run before CFD under gate_scope (probe: crossing-slope report-only; proposal: all hard); a proposal failing a gate is excluded with the reason recorded, a gate failure on a ladder step is a REJECT of that step, not a dropped step
preconditions_E4.lowdim_scripts: frozen: reuse by copy-adapt into new modules, never edits; every existing freeze --verify must keep holding
preconditions_E4.new_parent: the LOWDIM-04B selected state, reconstructed with construct_state from the pinned parent, direction, step 0.3125 mm, sign +1 and hash-checked against the 04B inventory; generation = parent + 1
preconditions_E4.stop_rule: step 3 starts only if this parent passes GEOM-02 profile v2 (all gates, transition from its own parent), P22-v2 and the retained LOWDIM gates

predecessor_contract.difference: contract_id, version, plan pin, predecessor_contract, non_blind_v1_1, D3_update.gate_scope, D3_update.constraints.geom02_gate_profile_v2, preconditions_E4.gate_order; all else identical. v1 stays as history.
